subject.title: [Bug]: Discord media uploads lose content-type and animated images lose frames

question: Should maintainers repair the open linked PR, replace it with a narrower PR, or defer the shared WebP/animated optimization behavior change?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and paired with an open closing PR, but the current candidate is dirty and changes shared media optimization behavior, so automation should not queue a competing fix without maintainer direction.

options.title: Repair the linked PR
options.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/41265 and get it to a clean, proven state that covers all Discord upload paths and the intended WebP/animated media behavior.

options.title: Replace with a narrower PR
options.body: Open a maintainer-owned replacement only if the linked branch is not worth repairing, preserving the useful tests and issue linkage.

options.title: Defer shared media policy
options.body: Keep the issue open but explicitly split the MIME threading fix from the broader WebP/animated optimizer policy if maintainers want a smaller first change.

recommendation.title: Repair the linked PR
recommendation.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/41265 and get it to a clean, proven state that covers all Discord upload paths and the intended WebP/animated media behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent blame and path history make this the strongest available routing candidate for deciding whether to repair or replace the current candidate branch.
